svg.title: Mutable names and immutable content identities
svg.desc: A mutable registry tag points to an index or manifest digest. A multi-platform index selects a platform manifest. Separate review of SBOM, provenance, signatures and vulnerabilities is still required; a digest alone is not trust.

g.text: Identity and trust answer different questions
Registry tag: a name that can move
SBOM + provenance + identity policy + vulnerability response
Exact content identity ≠ automatically trusted content
